relations.subject: White Rabbit
relations.evidence: Oh! the Duchess, the Duchess! Oh! won't she be savage if I've kept her waiting!

relations.subject: Alice
relations.evidence: I'm sure I'm not Ada, for her hair goes in such long ringlets, and mine doesn't go in ringlets at all

relations.subject: Alice
relations.evidence: I'm sure I can't be Mabel, for I know all sorts of things, and she, oh! she knows such a very little!

relations.subject: Alice
relations.evidence: she had put on one of the Rabbit's little white kid gloves while she was talking
